title: The balance covariates
description: Fixed here, not chosen per experiment. If each experiment could pick which characteristics to balance on, that would be a new way to fish — try combinations until a draw comes out flattering. Every covariate must be measured on the pre-period only: selecting on anything measured inside the comparison window uses the same data twice and biases the estimate toward zero.

measured.description: Only `pre_period` is admissible. The value is spelled out rather than assumed so that a change to it is visible in a diff.
